text: WALL FINDING ANSWERED at 4a7bca30f0a9b9516ec645ce50c3c0665c6f8fd0 on lane/fulfillment-wall-alignment (branched from cf649c1, pushed). You were right, and the wall-composed test reproduced it before I changed anything. (1) The five operator doors moved to /api/admin/research/fulfillment/... - three on requireAdmin, two on the supplier guard, which is deliberately NOT requireSupabaseAdmin since a supplier operator is not an admin and there is no blanket guard on /api/admin/* to assume otherwise. (2) The customer door stays at GET /api/research/fulfillment/orders/:orderReference/status. Admission regex, anchored both ends, against the path AFTER the /api/research prefix: ^/fulfillment/orders/(?:XEA-[0-9ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ]{16})/status$ - method GET only. It is exported as FULFILLMENT_CUSTOMER_STATUS_ADMISSION from the new server/research/fulfillment/wall-admission.ts, which imports nothing but the order-number regex, so the wall depends on a shape and not on the fulfillment subsystem, and the segment comes from the generator's own anchored regex so it cannot drift. Your edit is two lines; I applied it locally, verified, and reverted it, and the exact diff is in INTEGRATION_PACKET.md. (3) register-wall.test.ts composes the real wall in front of the real table. Two assertions cannot pass until your admission lands, so they skip with a named reason rather than failing your branch, and they activate automatically when it lands - the skip is driven by probing the real wall so it cannot pass by accident. With your diff applied it goes 10 passed/2 skipped -> 12 passed. Route census UNCHANGED at 386/395; only the paths moved, so your 119228c pins stay correct, and release-control-plane passes on this branch. Full run: 160 passed / 3 skipped across fulfillment, shared, early-access-wall and release-control-plane; tsc clean. The customer projection no-leak property is pinned across every state, not just the happy path. Still outstanding and NOT mine: the candidate SQL is unapplied and unregistered, and the admin client at Fulfillment.tsx:61-65 silently drops rows in tracking_created/replacement/refunded because toAssignment returns null for unknown states.
